enabled.title: Enable GraphJin Agent
enabled.description: Parsed dev and agentic service configs default to enabled; prod and direct Go configs remain disabled

api_key_file.title: Agent API Key File
api_key_file.description: Path of a file holding the provider key; read per request so rewriting it rotates the key without a restart. Mutually exclusive with api_key_env

service_tier.title: Agent Service Tier
service_tier.description: Portable inference service tier; auto delegates to the provider

structured_output_mode.title: Agent Structured Output Mode
structured_output_mode.description:
StructuredOutputMode selects the Ax structured-output mechanism. "auto"
lets the deployment profile and its model rules choose the mechanism Ax
has verified for that pairing; the explicit values are an override.

response_format.title: Agent Response Format (deprecated: use structured_output_mode)
response_format.description:
ResponseFormat is the deprecated predecessor of StructuredOutputMode:
json_schema maps to native, json_object to json_object. Set only one.

reasoning.title: Agent Reasoning Effort
reasoning.description: Provider thinking effort for models that support it: none low medium high xhigh

show_thoughts.title: Return Model Reasoning
show_thoughts.description: Return the provider's reasoning text in the chat log for debugging

temperature.title: Agent Sampling Temperature
temperature.description: Provider sampling temperature; unset leaves the stack default

top_p.title: Agent Sampling Top-P
top_p.description: Provider nucleus sampling cutoff; unset leaves the stack default

write_approval.title: Agent Write Approval
write_approval.description:
WriteApproval is "required" to hold every agent data write for the
user's approval, or "off" to run writes directly. Empty lets the
service decide: required in agentic mode.

write_approval_ttl.title: Agent Write Approval TTL
write_approval_ttl.description:
WriteApprovalTTL is how long a held write stays approvable, as a Go
duration such as "24h". Empty means 24h.

service_identity.title: Agent Service Identity
service_identity.description:
ServiceIdentity is the identity an organization agent acts as in the
background: an admin marks a saved agent runs_as service, and routines
an admin owns on that agent run as this identity, recording who
delegated them.

budgets.title: Agent Budgets
budgets.description: Budgets cap model usage per person and per routine over a rolling day.

autonomy.title: Agent Autonomy Rules
autonomy.description:
Autonomy lets some held writes run at once: per action and table, ask
(the default), notify (run, then tell the owner) or auto (run and
record), checked against the rows the dry run changed.

seed_limit.title: Agent Seed Catalog Limit
seed_limit.description: SeedLimit caps the initial query_catalog(search: instruction) seed rows.

catalog_default_limit.title: Agent Catalog Default Limit
catalog_default_limit.description: CatalogDefaultLimit is the default row limit for model-issued catalog queries.

lead.title: Lead Agent
lead.description: Lead is the conversational agent that delegates questions to this one.

enabled.title: Enable Artifacts
enabled.description: Enable the GraphJin-managed SQL artifact store for saved queries/fragments/workflows and catalog annotations; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled

source.title: Artifact Source
source.description: Database source name that hosts the artifact store; omitted dev and agentic configs use private managed SQLite while legacy explicit enablement uses the first writable SQL source

schema.title: Artifact Schema
schema.description: Schema for the artifact store tables

auto_init.title: Auto Initialize Artifact Tables
auto_init.description: Create artifact store tables automatically at startup

globals_path.title: Global Config Artifact Path
globals_path.description: Directory of read-only global artifacts loaded from config files

locked.title: Locked Artifact Kinds
locked.description: Artifact kinds that refuse writes through gj_artifacts

poll_seconds.title: Artifact Poll Seconds
poll_seconds.description: Fallback and reconnect interval for internal artifact and watch revision subscriptions

projection_content_max_bytes.title: Projection Content Max Bytes
projection_content_max_bytes.description: Per-field byte cap for content and JSON fields in the in-memory gj_artifacts search projection; oversized values are dropped from the projection but stay fully readable through the artifact store

max_per_owner.title: Max Artifacts Per Owner
max_per_owner.description: Shared maximum catalog-visible saved-query fragment and workflow artifacts per owner; existing rows remain updatable at the cap

ArtifactsConfig.description: ArtifactsConfig declares the GraphJin-managed SQL artifact store.

development.title: Development Mode
development.description: Enable development mode used to set credentials in the header and vars for testing

type.title: Type
type.description: Type can be one of jwt or header

cookie.title: Cookie Name
cookie.description: The name of the cookie that holds the authentication token

Auth.description: Auth struct contains authentication related config values used by the GraphJin service

scheme.description: Scheme: bearer | basic | api_key | oauth2_client_credentials | token_exchange

token.description:
Bearer: use either a static/env-supplied token or TokenFromRequest.
GraphQL and HTTP MCP forward only explicitly configured credential headers.

request.description:
token_exchange — generic "POST credentials → JSON with token" flow.
Covers Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization and similar
vendor-specific token endpoints that aren't standard OAuth2.

attach_as.description: How the resolved token attaches to outgoing operation requests.

cache_ttl.description:
CacheTTL overrides the token cache TTL when the auth response
doesn't include an expires_in field. Format: Go duration ("3500s").

AuthConfig.description: AuthConfig describes how outgoing requests to the upstream are authenticated.

token_ttl.title: Issued Token TTL
token_ttl.description: TTL of issued local JWTs (default: 720h = 30 days)

issuer.title: JWT Issuer Claim
issuer.description:
Issuer value stamped onto every locally-minted JWT. Must match
`auth.jwt.issuer` if that is set.

audience.title: JWT Audience Claim
audience.description:
Audience value stamped onto every locally-minted JWT. Must match
`auth.jwt.audience` if that is set. Defaults to "graphjin-cli".

audience_graphjin.title: Use GraphJin Default Audience (graphjin-cli)
audience_graphjin.description:
AudienceGraphjin is a convenience shortcut: when true, the issued JWT's
`aud` claim is set to the canonical value "graphjin-cli". Saves having
to remember / type the magic string. Mutually exclusive with Audience.

oidc.title: OIDC Provider
oidc.description: OIDC identity provider used to authenticate humans.

AuthLogin.description: AuthLogin configures the built-in OIDC sign-in flow that issues local JWTs for `deeporg cli` / `deeporg mcp` clients.

issuer_url.title: OIDC Issuer URL
issuer_url.description:
OIDC issuer URL — discovery happens at
<issuer_url>/.well-known/openid-configuration

client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Registered OAuth client ID / secret for this GraphJin deployment.

allowed_emails.title: Allowed Email Addresses
allowed_emails.description:
Optional post-authentication allow-lists. If both are empty, any verified
identity is accepted.

AuthLoginOIDC.description: AuthLoginOIDC configures a generic OIDC identity provider for AuthLogin.

action.description: Action is data.insert, data.update or data.delete.

table.description: Table is the table the write changes, or * for any table.

level.description: Level is ask, notify or auto.

max_rows.description:
MaxRows caps the rows the dry run may change for the rule to apply;
zero means no cap.

AutonomyRule.description: AutonomyRule is one row of agent.autonomy.

enabled.description: Enabled turns budgets on or off; unset follows the mode.

user_daily_tokens.description:
UserDailyTokens caps one person's agent runs, including runs made on
their behalf. Zero means the default (20,000,000, about 280 lead turns).

routine_daily_tokens.description:
RoutineDailyTokens caps one watch routine, its continuations included.
Zero means the default (2,000,000).

BudgetConfig.description: BudgetConfig caps model tokens over a rolling 24 hours.

disable.title: Disable Caching
disable.description: Disable response caching (caching is enabled by default)

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: Default TTL for cached responses in seconds (hard TTL)

fresh_ttl.title: Fresh TTL for SWR
fresh_ttl.description: Soft TTL for stale-while-revalidate in seconds (0 = disabled)

CachingConfig.description: CachingConfig configures response caching Caching is enabled by default using in-memory LRU cache Configure redis.url to use Redis for distributed caching Responses are cached with automatic invalidation when mutations modify related tables

allow_filtering.title: Allow Filtering
allow_filtering.description:
AllowFiltering is the only ALLOW FILTERING escape hatch — enable only for
known-small tables. It never relaxes OR/NOT/LIKE/IS NULL rejections.

partition_keys.title: Partition Keys
partition_keys.description: PartitionKeys / ClusteringKeys optionally override the introspected key roles.

enabled.title: Enable Catalog Graph
enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether GraphJin exposes catalog tables.
When omitted, it defaults to enabled in dev and disabled in production.

database.title: Catalog Database
database.description: Database is the virtual database name. Defaults to "graphjin".

samples.title: Catalog Sample Mode
samples.description:
Samples controls whether live sample/profile data is inlined or fetched on
demand. Default: on_demand.

auto_code_relations.title: Auto Code Relations
auto_code_relations.description:
AutoCodeRelations controls automatic relationships from catalog/schema
tables to CodeSQL's code_db_refs. When omitted, it follows Enabled.

code_databases.title: CodeSQL Databases
code_databases.description:
CodeDatabases optionally pins which CodeSQL database should be linked.
Empty means auto-detect, but only when exactly one CodeSQL DB exists.

CatalogConfig.description: CatalogConfig controls the managed AI-first catalog graph database.

merge_on_update.title: Merge On Update
merge_on_update.description:
MergeOnUpdate makes updates to this JSON column merge the new keys into
the stored document instead of replacing it. Postgres jsonb only.

Column.description: Configuration for a database table column

ConcurrencyConfig.description: ConcurrencyConfig bounds outgoing-request fan-out per spec.

max_connections.title: Maximum Connections
max_connections.description: Max number of active database connections allowed

max_connection_idle_time.title: Connection Idel Time
max_connection_idle_time.description: Max time after which idle database connections are closed

max_connection_life_time.title: Connection Life Time
max_connection_life_time.description: Max time after which database connections are not reused

ping_timeout.title: Healthcheck Ping Timeout
ping_timeout.description: Database ping timeout is used for db health checking

enable_tls.title: Enable TLS
enable_tls.description: Set up an secure TLS encrypted database connection

server_name.title: TLS Server Name
server_name.description:
Required for TLS. For example with Google Cloud SQL it's
<gcp-project-id>:<cloud-sql-instance>

server_cert.title: Server Certificate
server_cert.description: Required for TLS. Can be a file path or the contents of the PEM file

client_cert.title: Client Certificate
client_cert.description: Required for TLS. Can be a file path or the contents of the PEM file

client_key.title: Client Key
client_key.description: Required for TLS. Can be a file path or the contents of the pem file

encrypt.title: MSSQL Encrypt
encrypt.description: MSSQL: disable TLS encryption (default: true in go-mssqldb)

trust_server_certificate.title: MSSQL Trust Server Certificate
trust_server_certificate.description: MSSQL: trust server certificate without validation

private_key_path.title: Private Key File Path (Snowflake)
private_key_path.description:
Snowflake key pair authentication (PKCS#8 PEM format).
Generate key: openssl genrsa 2048 | openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -inform PEM -out rsa_key.p8

consistency.title: Cassandra Consistency Level
consistency.description: Cassandra / Amazon Keyspaces consistency level (default LOCAL_QUORUM).

type.title: Database Type
type.description: Database type (postgres, mysql, mariadb, sqlite, oracle, mongodb, snowflake, nanodb)

connection_string.title: Connection String
connection_string.description: Connection string for the database (alternative to individual params)

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Schema name to use (for databases that support schemas)

encrypt.title: MSSQL Encrypt
encrypt.description: MSSQL-specific: disable TLS encryption (go-mssqldb defaults to encrypt=true)

trust_server_certificate.title: MSSQL Trust Server Certificate
trust_server_certificate.description: MSSQL-specific: trust server certificate without validation

private_key_path.title: Private Key File Path (Snowflake)
private_key_path.description:
Snowflake key pair authentication (PKCS#8 PEM format).
Generate key: openssl genrsa 2048 | openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -inform PEM -out rsa_key.p8

read_only.title: Read Only
read_only.description:
Read-only mode — blocks all mutations and DDL against this database.
Once set in config, cannot be changed at runtime via MCP tools.

infer_db_refs.title: Infer Database References
infer_db_refs.description:
InferDBRefs controls CodeSQL's best-effort code-to-database reference
inference. It is only used for databases with type: codesql.

DatabaseConfig.description: DatabaseConfig defines configuration for a single database in multi-database mode

Delete.description: Table configuration for deleting from a table with a role

enabled.title: Enable Discovery Cache
enabled.description:
Enabled starts GraphJin Service from validated filesystem generations and
moves schema refreshes onto the coordinated generation path.

path.title: Discovery Cache Path
path.description:
Path stores immutable full schema snapshots, manifests, activation
receipts, and semantic indexes. Horizontal replicas must share this path.

refresh_interval.title: Discovery Refresh Interval
refresh_interval.description: RefreshInterval controls background live-schema checks after startup.

startup_wait.title: Discovery Startup Wait
startup_wait.description: StartupWait bounds cold follower and explicit refresh activation waits.

retain_generations.title: Retained Discovery Generations
retain_generations.description:
RetainGenerations is the number of activated generations kept when the
configured filesystem supports deletion.

DiscoveryCacheConfig.description: DiscoveryCacheConfig configures service-owned schema discovery generations.

version.title: Federation Version
version.description:
Version is the Federation spec version surfaced via @link.
Defaults to "v2.5" when empty.

keys.title: Federation Keys
keys.description:
Keys overrides the auto-derived @key for the named table. Each
entry is a list of column names that compose the key.

shareable.title: Shareable Fields
shareable.description: Shareable, Inaccessible and Tags accept "Type.field" identifiers.

FederationConfig.description: FederationConfig configures Apollo Federation v2 subgraph emission.

name.title: Table Name
name.description: Name is the table name surfaced in GraphQL (e.g. "avatars").

backend.title: Backend
backend.description:
Backend selects the implementation: "local", "s3", or "gcs".
S3 and GCS are gated by build tags; on a slim build, configuring
them produces a clear error.

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: Bucket is the S3 bucket / GCS bucket name. Ignored for local.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region is the S3 region (e.g. "us-east-1"). Ignored for local/gcs.

endpoint.title: Endpoint Override
endpoint.description:
Endpoint, when non-empty, overrides the S3 endpoint URL — useful
for MinIO, localstack, or non-AWS S3-compatible services.

prefix.title: Key Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix is prepended to every key. Effective root for the table.

root.title: Local Root Directory
root.description:
Root is the local filesystem root directory. Required for the
local backend; ignored otherwise.

presign_ttl.title: Presigned URL TTL
presign_ttl.description:
PresignTTL bounds how long generated presigned URLs are valid.
Defaults to 15 minutes when zero. Local backend ignores this.

public_base_url.title: Public Base URL
public_base_url.description:
PublicBaseURL, when set, replaces the presigned-URL host. Useful
when objects are fronted by a CDN. The path is appended unchanged.

read_only.title: Read Only
read_only.description:
ReadOnly disables GraphJin-managed writes and local filesystem watch
invalidation for this filesystem table.

max_list_page_size.title: Max List Page Size
max_list_page_size.description:
MaxListPageSize caps the number of entries returned per list call.
Defaults to 1000 when zero.

FilesystemConfig.description: FilesystemConfig declares one filesystem-backed virtual table.

group_claims.title: Group Claims
group_claims.description:
GroupClaims names the token claims that list the caller's groups. The
values are exposed to filters and presets as the trusted $user_groups variable.

role_mode.title: Role Mode
role_mode.description:
RoleMode selects how GraphJin resolves a caller with several matching
roles: "first" applies the first configured role, "union" merges the
table rules of every matching role.

IdentityConfig.description: IdentityConfig declares how request-wide identity is extracted in source mode.

Insert.description: Table configuration for inserting into a table with a role

provider.title: JWT Provider
provider.description: Provider can be one of auth0, firebase, jwks or other

secret.title: JWT Secret Key
secret.description: The secret key used for signing and encrypting the JWT token

public_key.title: Public Key
public_key.description:
Public keys can be used instead of using a secret
PublicKeyFile points to the file containing the public key

public_key_type.title: Public Key File Type
public_key_type.description: Public key file type can be one of ecdsa or rsa

audience.title: Match Audience Value
audience.description: Audience value that the JWT token needs to match

issuer.title: Match Issuer Value
issuer.description:
Issuer value that the JWT token needs to match:
Example: http://my-domain.auth0.com

jwks_url.title: JWKS Endpoint URL
jwks_url.description:
Sets the url of the JWKS endpoint.
Example: https://YOUR_DOMAIN/.well-known/jwks.json

jwks_refresh.title: JWKS Refresh Timeout (minutes)
jwks_refresh.description: Sets in minutes interval between refreshes, overriding the adaptive token refreshing

jwks_min_refresh.title: JWKS Minimum Refresh Timeout (minutes)
jwks_min_refresh.description:
JWKSMinRefresh sets in minutes fallback value when tokens are refreshed, default
to 60 minutes

JWTConfig.description: JWTConfig struct contains JWT authentication related config values used by the GraphJin service

param.description: OpenAPI param name receiving the column value

expose_as.description: GraphQL field name on the parent

JoinConfig.description: JoinConfig wires an operation to a DB table+column.

KeystoreConfig.description: KeystoreConfig configures the local encrypted keystore.

enabled.title: Enable Lead Agent
enabled.description: Parsed dev and agentic configs default to agent.enabled

api_key_env.title: Lead API Key Environment Variable
api_key_env.description: Required when the lead provider differs from agent.provider

reasoning.title: Lead Reasoning Effort
reasoning.description: none low medium high xhigh; empty inherits agent.reasoning

max_steps.title: Lead Max Steps
max_steps.description: MaxSteps bounds the lead's model calls in one turn.

max_parallel.title: Lead Max Parallel Questions
max_parallel.description: MaxParallel bounds how many delegated questions run at once.

max_questions.title: Lead Max Questions Per Turn
max_questions.description: MaxQuestions bounds delegated questions in one turn.

LeadConfig.description: LeadConfig selects the lead's model and bounds its fan-out.

disable.title: Disable MCP Server
disable.description:
Disable the MCP server. MCP is enabled by default except for legacy
database-only prod/agentic configs, where it must be explicitly enabled.

oauth.title: MCP OAuth Configuration
oauth.description: OAuth exposes standards-compatible authorization discovery for remote MCP clients.

allow_mutations.title: Allow Mutations
allow_mutations.description:
Allow mutation operations via raw MCP GraphQL execution.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_raw_queries.title: Allow Raw Queries
allow_raw_queries.description:
Allow arbitrary GraphQL queries (vs only saved queries from allow-list)
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

include_tools_with_agent.title: Include MCP Tools With Agent
include_tools_with_agent.description: Parsed dev and agentic configs default to true; prod and direct Go configs remain false

legacy_discovery.title: Enable Legacy Discovery Tools
legacy_discovery.description:
LegacyDiscovery keeps legacy HTTP helper endpoints such as
/api/v1/discovery and /api/v1/workflows available for compatibility.
It no longer expands the MCP tool surface; MCP is catalog-first.

stdio_user_id.title: Stdio User ID
stdio_user_id.description: Default user ID for stdio transport (CLI). Can be overridden by GRAPHJIN_USER_ID env var.

stdio_user_role.title: Stdio User Role
stdio_user_role.description: Default user role for stdio transport (CLI). Can be overridden by GRAPHJIN_USER_ROLE env var.

only.title: MCP Only Mode
only.description:
Run in MCP-only mode - disables GraphQL, REST saved-query API, WebUI, and OpenAPI endpoints.
Health check and MCP endpoints remain available. Legacy HTTP helper endpoints
also remain available only when legacy_discovery is enabled.

cursor_cache_ttl.title: Cursor Cache TTL
cursor_cache_ttl.description:
CursorCacheTTL in seconds for cursor ID cache (default: 1800 = 30 min)
Cursors are cached to allow short numeric IDs for LLM-friendly pagination

cursor_cache_size.title: Cursor Cache Size
cursor_cache_size.description: CursorCacheSize max entries for in-memory cursor cache fallback (default: 10000)

allow_config_updates.title: Allow Config Updates
allow_config_updates.description:
AllowConfigUpdates enables MCP tools that can modify GraphJin configuration
WARNING: Allows LLMs to change database connections, table configs, and roles
Only enable in trusted environments. Default: false

allow_schema_reload.title: Allow Schema Reload
allow_schema_reload.description:
AllowSchemaReload enables the MCP reload_schema tool for manual schema refresh
Useful when user adds tables and wants immediate discovery without waiting for poll
Default: false (auto-enabled in dev mode if not explicitly set)

allow_schema_updates.title: Allow Schema Updates
allow_schema_updates.description:
AllowSchemaUpdates enables MCP tools to preview and apply database schema changes (DDL)
Uses GraphJin DDL (db.ddl) format. Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_workflow_updates.title: Allow Workflow Updates
allow_workflow_updates.description:
AllowWorkflowUpdates enables workflow writes through gj_workflow.
Saved workflows are discoverable via workflow catalog items. Execution
through gj_workflow_execution is controlled by normal read_only table/source
configuration because it is an insert-shaped managed mutation.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_workflow_execution.title: Allow Workflow Execution
allow_workflow_execution.description:
AllowWorkflowExecution keeps the legacy HTTP workflow execution surface
available when legacy discovery is enabled. MCP workflow execution uses
catalog discovery plus gj_workflow_execution.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_dev_tools.title: Allow Dev Tools
allow_dev_tools.description:
AllowDevTools enables advanced introspection MCP tools (explain_query, explore_relationships, audit_role_permissions).
These expose SQL, relationship graphs, and role permissions — useful for development/debugging.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

default_db_allowed.title: Allow Default Databases
default_db_allowed.description:
DefaultDBAllowed when true allows configuring and discovering system/default
databases (e.g. postgres, mysql, master). Default: false

workflow_timeout.title: Workflow Timeout (seconds)
workflow_timeout.description:
WorkflowTimeout in seconds for JavaScript workflow execution.
Workflows that exceed this duration are interrupted. Default: 5

config_update_timeout.title: Config Update Timeout (seconds)
config_update_timeout.description:
ConfigUpdateTimeout in seconds bounds a gj_config mutation or an
update_current_config call. An update that changes an API source
rediscovers every database source, which on a large schema takes as
long as a restart. Default: 3600

MCPConfig.description: MCPConfig configures the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server MCP enables AI assistants to interact with GraphJin via function calling

enabled.title: Enable MCP OAuth
enabled.description: Enable OAuth metadata/challenge support for the MCP HTTP endpoint.

mode.title: MCP OAuth Mode
mode.description:
Mode selects the authorization-server strategy: builtin uses auth_login
to run an authorization-code + PKCE flow; external advertises the
configured AuthorizationServers and validates bearer tokens via auth.jwt.

resource.title: MCP OAuth Resource
resource.description:
Resource is the expected OAuth audience/resource value. Defaults to the
public /api/v1/mcp URL for the incoming request.

issuer.title: MCP OAuth Issuer
issuer.description:
Issuer is the authorization server issuer. In builtin mode it defaults to
the public origin of the incoming request.

authorization_servers.title: MCP OAuth Authorization Servers
authorization_servers.description:
AuthorizationServers are advertised by protected-resource metadata in
external mode. Defaults to Issuer when empty.

scopes.title: MCP OAuth Scopes
scopes.description: Scopes advertised and accepted by the MCP authorization server.

dynamic_client_registration.title: Enable MCP OAuth Dynamic Client Registration
dynamic_client_registration.description: DynamicClientRegistration exposes RFC 7591 registration in builtin mode.

client_id_metadata_documents.title: Enable MCP OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents
client_id_metadata_documents.description: ClientIDMetadataDocuments lets clients use CIMD URLs instead of DCR.

access_token_ttl.title: MCP OAuth Access Token TTL
access_token_ttl.description: AccessTokenTTL controls builtin-mode access token lifetime.

refresh_token_ttl.title: MCP OAuth Refresh Token TTL
refresh_token_ttl.description: RefreshTokenTTL controls builtin-mode refresh token lifetime.

MCPOAuthConfig.description: MCPOAuthConfig configures standards-compatible OAuth discovery and token handling for hosted MCP HTTP clients.

enabled.title: Enable Agent Memory
enabled.description: Parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled when artifacts are enabled

MemoryConfig.description: MemoryConfig configures agent memory: short personal or team facts stored as memory artifacts and recalled into each agent run.

enabled.title: Enable Metadata Graph
enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether GraphJin exposes discovered metadata tables.
When omitted, it defaults to enabled in dev and disabled in production.

database.title: Metadata Database
database.description: Database is the virtual database name. Defaults to "graphjin".

auto_code_relations.title: Auto Code Relations
auto_code_relations.description:
AutoCodeRelations controls automatic relationships from catalog items
to CodeSQL's public gj_code projection. When omitted, it follows Enabled.

code_databases.title: CodeSQL Databases
code_databases.description:
CodeDatabases optionally pins which CodeSQL database should be linked.
Empty means auto-detect, but only when exactly one CodeSQL DB exists.

MetadataConfig.description: MetadataConfig controls the managed metadata graph database.

expose_mutation.description:
ExposeMutation is the explicit opt-in required for every non-GET
operation. Merely appearing in an OpenAPI document never exposes a write.

allowed_roles.description:
AllowedRoles is an additional runtime allowlist layered on top of source
capability and access policy checks.

retry_on_auth_failure.description:
RetryOnAuthFailure permits one 401 token-refresh retry. It defaults to
false for mutations because blindly replaying a write is unsafe.

defaults.description: Defaults supplies fallback values for path/query params; caller args win.

OperationOverride.description: OperationOverride applies presentation, classification, and mutation-policy settings to an operation.

column.title: Partition Column
column.description: Column is the partition key column name (e.g., "created_at").

default_range_days.title: Default Range Days
default_range_days.description:
DefaultRangeDays is the number of days to auto-filter when no partition filter
is present in the query. Set to 0 to only warn without injecting a filter.

PartitionConfig.description: PartitionConfig declares the partition key for a warehouse table.

filters.description: Use filters to enforce table wide things like { disabled: false } where you never want disabled users to be shown.

Query.description: Table configuration for querying a table with a role

requests_per_minute.title: Agent Provider Requests Per Minute
requests_per_minute.description: Process-local rolling-minute request ceiling; zero disables request limiting

tokens_per_minute.title: Agent Provider Tokens Per Minute
tokens_per_minute.description: Process-local rolling-minute provider-reported token ceiling; zero disables token limiting

RateLimitConfig.description: RateLimitConfig sets process-local limits for model calls made with the server-owned agent provider.

rate.title: Connection Rate
rate.description: The number of events per second

bucket.title: Bucket Size
bucket.description: Bucket a burst of at most 'bucket' number of events

ip_header.title: IP From HTTP Header
ip_header.description: The header that contains the client ip

RateLimiter.description: RateLimiter sets the API rate limits

RoleTable.description: Table configuration for a specific role (user role)

max_events.title: Runtime Event Limit
max_events.description: MaxEvents is the maximum number of recent event rows retained.

ttl_seconds.title: Runtime Event TTL Seconds
ttl_seconds.description: TTLSeconds controls how long event rows are retained.

RuntimeEventsConfig.description: RuntimeEventsConfig configures bounded agentic runtime observability rows.

SecretsConfig.description: SecretsConfig configures secret storage for write-only config inputs.

SelectionConfig.description: SelectionConfig configures the independent, tool-less Ax decision stage.

enabled.title: Enable Semantic Catalog Search
enabled.description: Enabled adds Ax-backed semantic recall to the lexical catalog baseline.

provider.title: Embedding Provider
provider.description: Provider is the Ax embedding provider name.

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description:
EmbeddingModel is required when semantic search is enabled and forms part
of the persisted embedding-space fingerprint.

api_key_env.title: Embedding API Key Environment Variable
api_key_env.description: APIKeyEnv names the environment variable containing the provider key.

base_url.title: Embedding Provider Base URL
base_url.description:
BaseURL optionally overrides the provider endpoint and forms part of the
persisted embedding-space fingerprint.

dimensions.title: Embedding Dimensions
dimensions.description:
Dimensions selects tiny (768), small (1536), medium (3072), or the
provider-native default. Named sizes are validated strictly.

SemanticCatalogSearchConfig.description: SemanticCatalogSearchConfig configures the service-owned Ax embedding layer.

ServiceIdentityConfig.description: ServiceIdentityConfig is agent.service_identity: a user id and a configured role an organization agent runs as.

SourceAccessConfig.description: SourceAccessConfig declares source-level access defaults plus table/root classifications.

SourceAccessGrant.description: SourceAccessGrant gives one role read access to tables of a database source.

SourceAccessGrantTable.description: SourceAccessGrantTable sets the columns and the row filter of a grant.

SourceConfig.description: SourceConfig declares one external provider in sources.

base_url.description:
BaseURL overrides the spec's servers[0].url. Useful when the spec
hard-codes a sandbox/prod URL that doesn't match the deployment, or
when env-var interpolation is needed (e.g. https://${IS_ACCOUNT}...).

auth.description:
Auth carries credentials and the auth flow shape. One AuthConfig per
spec — we don't currently support per-operation auth.

joins.description:
Joins maps an operationId to a DB table/column. Without an entry, an
operation is still queryable as a top-level field; with an entry, it
also becomes a child field on the named DB table.

operations.description:
Operations carries per-operation overrides that aren't joins (e.g.
renaming the auto-exposed top-level field, overriding result_path).
Optional; auto-classification provides sensible defaults.

concurrency.description:
Concurrency bounds the goroutine fan-out and request rate per spec.
Without this, a 1000-row parent select would spawn 1000 parallel
HTTP calls to the upstream — a reliable way to get rate-limited.

timeout.title: Upstream Request Timeout
timeout.description:
Timeout bounds each upstream request, including token acquisition. Zero
selects DefaultTimeout. Keeping the bound per spec lets slower services
opt into a larger budget when GraphJin is embedded behind a compatible
outer HTTP deadline.

max_request_bytes.description:
MaxRequestBytes and MaxResponseBytes bound encoded request bodies and
upstream responses. Zero selects conservative package defaults.

document.title: OpenAPI Document
document.description:
Document holds the OpenAPI document itself, as YAML or JSON. It lets a
remote client add an API source through gj_config without access to the
server's specs directory. It takes precedence over a file with the
same key in specs_dir.

SpecConfig.description: SpecConfig is the per-spec section a user adds to the GraphJin config (keyed by spec filename without extension).

SystemConfig.description: SystemConfig controls GraphJin-owned capabilities and caller access to built-in gj_* roots.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source is required in sources used and points at one sources[].name.

database.title: Database
database.description:
Database name for multi-database support. References a key in Config.Databases.
If empty, uses the default database.

partition.title: Partition Configuration
partition.description:
Partition configuration for warehouse-optimized queries (Snowflake, BigQuery).
When set, queries without a filter on the partition column will either get a
default time-range filter injected or produce a warning.

cassandra.title: Cassandra Table Configuration
cassandra.description: Cassandra per-table options (allow_filtering escape hatch + key overrides).

enabled.title: Enable Tasks
enabled.description: Enable durable owner-scoped declared-intent tasks; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled when artifacts are enabled

max_entries_per_task.title: Max Entries Per Task
max_entries_per_task.description: Maximum stored trail entries per task; oldest are pruned first

entry_retention_hours.title: Task Entry Retention Hours
entry_retention_hours.description: Hours to keep task trail entries before prune-on-write and projection trimming

snapshot_max_bytes.title: Task Snapshot Max Bytes
snapshot_max_bytes.description: Byte cap for task snapshot_json and task-entry detail_json

TasksConfig.description: TasksConfig declares the GraphJin-managed durable declared-intent task store.

enabled.title: Enable Threads
enabled.description: Enable persistent owner-scoped agent threads; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled when artifacts and the agent are enabled

history_turns.title: History Turns
history_turns.description: Prior messages loaded from the thread into each agent run

run_lease_seconds.title: Run Lease Seconds
run_lease_seconds.description: How long a running agent run stays claimed without a heartbeat before another replica marks it failed

response_max_bytes.title: Response Max Bytes
response_max_bytes.description: Byte cap for the agent response stored with each assistant message; larger responses drop data and trace

ThreadsConfig.description: ThreadsConfig declares GraphJin-managed persistent agent threads.

TokenExchangeRequest.description: TokenExchangeRequest describes the POST shape used by token_exchange auth.

TokenExchangeResponse.description: TokenExchangeResponse describes how to extract the token and TTL from the auth endpoint's JSON response.

TokenFromRequest.description: TokenFromRequest selects a required incoming credential header.

Update.description: Table configuration for updating a table with a role

max_size.title: Max Upload Size (bytes)
max_size.description:
MaxSize is the per-request multipart body limit in bytes.
Defaults to 25 MB when zero.

allowed_mime.title: Allowed MIME Types
allowed_mime.description:
AllowedMIME, when non-empty, restricts the accepted content types.
Glob patterns are supported: "image/*", "application/pdf".

storage.title: Filesystem Table for Streaming
storage.description:
Storage names a filesystems[].name to stream uploads into. When
empty, the legacy inline-base64 mode is used. When set, files
are written to the backend and the variable becomes the object
metadata instead of inlined data.

storage_key_prefix.title: Storage Key Prefix
storage_key_prefix.description:
StorageKeyPrefix is prepended to the backend key for every
uploaded file. Useful for namespacing by tenant or role.
Example: "avatars/{date}/" — the {date} marker is substituted
at request time with YYYY/MM/DD.

UploadsConfig.description: UploadsConfig configures the multipart-form upload endpoint following the graphql-multipart-request-spec (https://github.com/jaydenseric/graphql-multipart-request-spec).

Upsert.description: Table configuration for creating/updating (upsert) a table with a role

enabled.title: Enable Watches
enabled.description: Enable durable owner-scoped watches; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled when artifacts are enabled

event_retention_hours.title: Watch Event Retention Hours
event_retention_hours.description: Hours to keep fired watch events before pruning

max_events_per_watch.title: Max Events Per Watch
max_events_per_watch.description: Maximum stored events per watch; oldest are pruned first

snapshot_max_bytes.title: Watch Snapshot Max Bytes
snapshot_max_bytes.description: Byte cap for stored event snapshots and user-supplied watch-definition JSON fields

runner.title: Watch Runner
runner.description: Which replicas evaluate watches; parsed dev and agentic configs default to all while literal and prod configs remain off

webhook_allow.title: Watch Webhook Allowlist
webhook_allow.description: Allowlist of webhook URL prefixes watch deliveries may call; empty denies all webhooks

enrichment_daily_cap.title: Watch Enrichment Daily Cap
enrichment_daily_cap.description: Maximum flow triage runs per watch per day

retry_max_failures.title: Watch Retry Max Failures
retry_max_failures.description: Consecutive transient runner failures before a watch enters terminal error status

WatchesConfig.description: WatchesConfig declares the GraphJin-managed watch store and runner settings.

WorkflowsConfig.description: WorkflowsConfig controls workflow discovery and permissions.

secret_key.title: Secret Key
secret_key.description: Is used to encrypt opaque values such as the cursor. Auto-generated when not set

disable_allow_list.title: Disable Allow List
disable_allow_list.description: When set to true it disables the allow list workflow

enable_schema.title: Enable Schema
enable_schema.description:
When set to true a database schema file will be generated in dev mode and
used in production mode. Auto database discovery will be disabled
in production mode.

enable_introspection.title: Generate introspection JSON
enable_introspection.description:
When set to true an introspection json file will be generated in dev mode.
This file can be used with other GraphQL tooling to generate clients, enable
autocomplete, etc

set_user_id.title: Set User ID
set_user_id.description: Forces the database session variable 'user.id' to be set to the user id

default_block.title: Block tables for anonymous users
default_block.description:
This ensures that for anonymous users (role 'anon') all tables are blocked
from queries and mutations. To open access to tables for anonymous users
they have to be added to the 'anon' role config

variables.title: Variables
variables.description:
This is a list of variables that can be leveraged in your queries.
(eg. variable admin_id will be $admin_id in the query)

header_variables.title: Header Variables
header_variables.description: This is a list of variables that map to http header values

blocklist.title: Block List
blocklist.description: A list of tables and columns that should disallowed in any and all queries

sources.title: Sources
sources.description:
Sources is the canonical external graph provider config. When present, all
SQL, CodeSQL, filesystem, and OpenAPI providers must be declared here.

system.title: System Features
system.description:
System configures GraphJin-owned roots. It is separate from Sources because
built-in functionality is not an external graph provider.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Workflows configures the built-in Goja JavaScript workflow feature.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description:
Identity declares the request-wide claims and optional enrichment query
used by source-mode access generation.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description:
Artifacts configures GraphJin-managed mutable agent artifacts exposed as
the gj_artifacts system root.

watches.title: Watches
watches.description:
Watches configures GraphJin-managed standing questions and durable inbox
events exposed as gj_watch and gj_watch_event system roots.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Tasks configures owner-scoped declared goals and their immutable trail.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description:
Threads configures persistent agent conversations: threads, messages,
runs and run events kept in the control-plane store.

openapi_specs_dir.title: OpenAPI Specs Directory
openapi_specs_dir.description:
OpenAPISpecsDir is the directory that GraphJin scans at startup for
OpenAPI 3 specification files (*.yaml / *.yml). Each spec dropped in
is parsed, classified, and exposed as remote-joinable fields and/or
top-level virtual tables. Defaults to "./config/specs" when empty.

openapi.title: Legacy OpenAPI Specifications
openapi.description:
OpenAPI carries per-spec configuration keyed by the spec filename
without extension (e.g. "interaction_studio" matches
"config/specs/interaction_studio.yaml"). Operations classifiable from
the spec are auto-exposed; entries here add credentials, base URL
overrides, DB-to-API join wiring, and concurrency caps.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description:
All table specific configuration such as aliased tables and relationships
between tables

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description:
Relationships adds graph edges between typed table columns. Cardinality is
inferred from existing primary/unique metadata and reverse edges are still
generated by the schema graph.

functions.title: Functions
functions.description: All function specific configuration such as return types

roles_query.title: Roles Query
roles_query.description:
An SQL query if set enables attribute based access control. This query is
used to fetch the user attribute that then dynamically define the users role

roles.description:
Roles contains the configuration for all the roles you want to support 'user' and
'anon' are two default roles. The 'user' role is used when a user ID is available
and 'anon' when it's not. Use the 'Roles Query' config to add more custom roles

db_type.title: Database Type
db_type.description: Database type name Defaults to 'postgres' (options: postgres, mysql, mariadb, sqlite, oracle, mssql, nanodb)

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Log warnings and other debug information

subs_poll_duration.title: Subscription Polling Duration
subs_poll_duration.description:
Database polling duration (in seconds) used by subscriptions to
query for updates.

subs_max_members_per_worker.title: Subscription Max Members Per Worker
subs_max_members_per_worker.description:
Upper bound on how many subscribers a single subscription poll cycle
will batch into one database query. The adaptive sizer never grows
past this value. When zero a sensible default is used.

subs_min_members_per_worker.title: Subscription Min Members Per Worker
subs_min_members_per_worker.description:
Lower bound on the adaptive subscription chunk size; prevents the
sizer from shrinking down to per-row queries under sustained load.
When zero a sensible default is used.

subs_target_query_latency.title: Subscription Target Query Latency
subs_target_query_latency.description: When zero this is auto-derived as 25% of subs_poll_duration

default_limit.title: Default Row Limit
default_limit.description:
The default max limit (number of rows) when a limit is not defined in
the query or the table role config.

analytics_mode.title: Analytics Mode
analytics_mode.description: Disable implicit row-limit defaults for OLAP deployments

disable_agg_functions.title: Disable Aggregations
disable_agg_functions.description: Disable all aggregation functions like count, sum, etc

disable_functions.title: Disable Functions
disable_functions.description: Disable all functions like count, length,  etc

mock_db.title: Mock DB
mock_db.description:
When set to true, GraphJin will not connect to a database and instead
return mock data based on the query structure.

enable_camelcase.title: Enable Camel Case
enable_camelcase.description: Enable automatic coversion of camel case in GraphQL to snake case in SQL

production.title: Production Mode
production.description: Legacy production switch. Prefer top-level mode for new configs.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Mode selects the deployment-mode defaults. Empty derives from Production.

db_schema_poll_duration.title: Schema Change Detection Polling Duration
db_schema_poll_duration.description: Duration for polling the database to detect schema changes

disable_production_security.title: Disable Production Security
disable_production_security.description: When set to true it disables production security features like enforcing the allow list

databases.title: Databases
databases.description:
Multiple database configurations for multi-database support.
When set, allows querying across multiple databases in a single GraphQL request.
Each database gets its own connection pool, schema, and SQL compiler.

federation.title: Apollo Federation v2
federation.description:
Federation opts the engine into Apollo Federation v2 subgraph mode.
When Federation.Enabled is true, `_service { sdl }` returns a
federation-flavoured SDL describing the schema's tables. See
FederationConfig for the full surface.

filesystems.title: Filesystem Tables
filesystems.description:
Filesystems exposes object stores (local directories, S3, GCS) as
virtual tables in the GraphQL schema. Each entry materialises one
table with a fixed shape — key/size/content_type/etag/modified_at/url/data —
and routes queries through a pluggable Backend.

metadata.title: Metadata Graph
metadata.description:
Metadata exposes GraphJin-discovered database metadata for legacy
internal helpers. Public GraphQL discovery should use gj_catalog
catalog items instead of separate table/column roots.

catalog.title: Catalog Graph
catalog.description:
Catalog exposes GraphJin's AI-first self-model as a managed read-only
database. It supersedes the older metadata-only graph.

app_name.title: Application Name
app_name.description: Application name is used in log and debug messages

disable_column_value_sampling.title: Disable Catalog Column Value Sampling
disable_column_value_sampling.description:
Stops the catalog from sampling the small value sets of enum-like columns
(status, severity, plan, and similar). Those sets let an agent filter on a
real value instead of inventing one, so leaving this off is recommended;
set it when even low-cardinality values must not appear in catalog cards.

config_path.title: Config Path
config_path.description: The default path to find all configuration files and scripts

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging level must be one of debug, error, warn, info

log_format.title: Logging Format
log_format.description:
Logging Format: "auto" (default, colored console in dev, JSON in production),
"json" (always JSON), or "simple" (always colored console)

host_port.title: Host and Port
host_port.description: The host and port the service runs on. Example localhost:8080

host.title: Host
host.description: Host to run the service on

port.title: Port
port.description: Port to run the service on

web_ui.title: Enable Web UI
web_ui.description: Enable the web UI. Defaults on in dev and agentic modes, off in prod.

eval_state_dir.title: Evaluation Report State Directory
eval_state_dir.description:
Evaluation report state directory for the non-production Trainer console.
Relative paths resolve from config_path. Set to "off" to disable the API.

reload_on_config_change.title: Reload Config
reload_on_config_change.description: Enables reloading the service on config changes. Disabled in production

auth_fail_block.title: Block Request on Authorization Failure
auth_fail_block.description: Enable blocking requests with a HTTP 401 on auth failure

cors_allowed_origins.title: HTTP CORS Allowed Origins
cors_allowed_origins.description: Sets the HTTP CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header

cors_allowed_headers.title: HTTP CORS Allowed Headers
cors_allowed_headers.description: Sets the HTTP CORS Access-Control-Allow-Headers header

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Sets the default authentication used by the service

memory.title: Agent Memory
memory.description: Persistent agent memory recalled into every agent run

auth_login.title: Built-in Login (OIDC)
auth_login.description: Built-in OIDC login that mints local JWTs for the CLI / MCP client

inherits.title: Inherit From Config File
inherits.description:
Name of another config file in the same directory to inherit and
override (one level only; the inherited file cannot itself inherit).
Example: prod.yml sets `inherits: dev` to start from dev.yml values.

title: GraphJin Configuration
description: Configuration for the GraphJin service and compiler core (dev.yml / prod.yml / agentic.yml).
